BiblicalUsage: Hoshama is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 3:18, the text says "Hoshama." The life behind the name is told on the Hoshama People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hoshama matters because God knows His people by name, and Hoshama is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
